name: MultiVPN
author: Nepomuk Software
description: Work OpenVPN, homelab WireGuard and GlobalProtect in one Omarchy bar icon. Split tunnels stay up together.

barWidget.description: One icon for every tunnel: OpenVPN, OpenVPN 3, WireGuard and GlobalProtect. Import a config, watch throughput, switch with a click.

schema.label: VPN type
schema.description: unified lists every VPN on the machine in one panel and follows whichever is connected. The single-backend modes pin the widget to one profile instead.

schema.label: Profile
schema.description: Single-backend modes: which profile the icon controls. In unified mode it is only the favourite that right-click connects when nothing is up.

schema.label: Status interval (seconds)
schema.description: While idle. During a transition and while the popup is open it polls faster on its own.

schema.label: Throughput in the bar
schema.description: Shows the current rate next to the icon while connected. No effect on vertical bars.

schema.label: Highlight when connected
schema.description: Tints the icon with the accent colour while the tunnel is up instead of just showing it at full opacity.

schema.label: Only show when connected
schema.description: Hides the icon entirely while the tunnel is down.
